name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.56.1 — build→review boundary (prax field report, 2026-09-02, the first full /spec:run loop): `spec-build-driver.js` refuses a re-run on a `status: implementing` spec with no sidecar once a `stage:"build"` ledger row names the spec (exit 2, the row and the review driver named, no sidecar opened) — the row's presence is the terminal outcome, so no outcome field is added; `layerGroups` groups with no File Plan rows are skipped at wave derivation (one printed line names them) instead of printing an empty dispatch step that demanded a `--workers 0` mark; `build.md`'s wave-derivation sentence now states that unlisted layers trail as one final `other` wave, and `run.md`'s Routing step 2 routes a spec carrying a build row to review. 7.56.0 — /spec:run is the loop (specs/20260901/10-spec-run-command.md): the unified loop moves from /spec:build to a new /spec:run, freeing /spec:build to return to being the build stage's direct entry alone (`hardened|implementing`, `--via direct`) beside /spec:design and /spec:review. `spec-state-gate.sh` admits /spec:run on `hardened|implementing|done` and refuses /spec:build on `done` (remedy names /spec:run); `spec-status.js`'s `deriveNext` emits `/spec:run` for every spec past `hardened`, shrinking the `--json` action set to `/spec:plan | /spec:run | /spec:escape`. `spec-paths shared-for run` serves the union of build's and review's doctrine sections; `entrypoints.json` adds `run.md` as an entry point of both drivers and report-render.js, and drops build.md's edge to spec-review-driver.js. `core.md`'s lifecycle sentence and § State Machine now name /spec:run as the loop. 7.55.0 — independent dispositions (specs/20260901/09-disposer-gate.md): the loop no longer parks after the reviewer returns to gate independence on a stale session id. `spec/agents/disposer.md` is a new fresh-context `spec:disposer` agent (`model: inherit`, read-only), dispatched at every DISPOSITIONS step on both review entries with no memory of the build; it returns one grounded `fix`/`waive`/`reject` recommendation per reviewer survivor and per failing non-blocking leg row. `spec-review-driver.js` refuses `--mark dispositions` on a non-empty pool without a disposer return covering every finding exactly once with a non-blank reason, records `disposer: {file, iteration, overrides}` in `review-state.json`, and retires the CHECKPOINT state, its session-id stamp comparison, and `--skip-independence-check-because` (refused by name, ADR-0005). `verdict.js`'s `--checkpoint` enum becomes `disposer|empty|not-reached` (`cleared`/`stamp-appeared`/`overridden` refused) with a new `--checkpoint-overrides <N>`, now accepted on `--via direct` and `--via` absent as well as `--via loop`; every review row's `checkpoint: {outcome, overrides}` records how often the user overrode the disposer. `review.md`'s DISPOSITIONS rule dispatches the disposer, applies `fix` recommendations without asking, and asks the user only on `waive`/`reject`; `build.md`'s enforced CHECKPOINT bullet is replaced by a no-stop bullet — independence is the disposer, on the loop path and the direct path alike.
